newsitem.title: USA: Corrpro suit settlement gets final approval.
newsitem.headline: Corrpro suit settlement gets final approval.

text.p: Corrpro Cos Inc said Wednesday that a U.S. District Court in Ohio gave final approval to the settlement in a class action and shareholder lawsuit filed against it.

As previously announced, the company and its insurer agreed to pay $6.1 million to settle the suits, for which the company recorded a pre-tax charge of about $2.4 million in its second quarter ended September 30.
"The final resolution of this litigation is a very positive event for the company, and we are extremely pleased to have this matter behind us," the company said in a release.
Corrpro provides corrosion control engineering services, systems and equipment to energy markets.
